features.description: Provider-response normalization with explicit Quantumult X and Surge adapters.

quantumultX.routing: The native geo_location_checker supplies the response; the script only parses it.

surge.routing: One lookup request uses the existing policy named by the script argument, Proxy by default; it does not change a group selection or represent every request.

validation.liveApi: Run separately; public IP responses are never committed as fixtures.

features.description: Optional native Bing-to-Google 302 redirect when q is the first query parameter.
